messages:
maya_newhire: hi team — a couple benefits/payroll micro-questions from my first week. 1) If I enroll in dental now, does coverage start immediately or is there a waiting period? 2) I bought a monitor for $220 for home setup — what's the expense path? 3) when's the first paycheck? not sure how semi-monthly proration works.

sophie (People Ops): welcome! :wave: Short answers: dental typically starts first of month after 30 days unless you picked expedited coverage. Monitor reimbursement goes through Ramp (category: Onboarding - Home Office). First pay follows semi-monthly cycle: 15th and last day. Details below.

maya_newhire: i started 2026-03-03, so dental would kick in 2026-05-01? that seems far out. any way to get earlier?

sophie (People Ops): For new hires there's a 30-day waiting rule. Expedited enrollment was offered at sign-up for some hires; if you didn't opt in, email benefits@redwood.com and we can see if vendor allows retro start (rare). For urgent procedures, benefits team can provide a summary letter to present to providers.

alec_finance: Expense steps: 1) Use Ramp to submit. 2) Category = "Onboarding - Home Office". 3) Attach receipt + short note. If you don't have Ramp access, use the Google expense form: https://forms.gle/expense-redwood and cc finance@redwood.com. Example note: 

```
Expense: Monitor purchase
Amount: $220.00
Date: 2026-03-05
Receipt: attached
Category: Onboarding - Home Office
Notes: One-time monitor purchase for remote setup
```

alec_finance: Approval turnaround is ~3 business days; reimbursement via payroll next cycle. If you need faster, mark urgent and we can push.

hr-bot: Reminder: Please complete benefits elections in Rippling by 2026-03-17 to avoid default plan assignment.

maya_newhire: thanks! last one: PTO — do new hires get floating holidays prorated? and does the portal show the exact available balance?

sophie (People Ops): Yes, floating holidays and PTO are prorated based on hire date and you'll see the prorated balance in Rippling within one pay cycle. If it doesn't show, DM me and we'll manual adjust. Company holidays list is on the handbook: https://intranet.redwood.com/handbook/time-off

maya_newhire: awesome, appreciate it. submitting Ramp now.
